quick.stay_put: 112: Please stay where you are and keep your phone with you.
quick.safe_place: 112: Move to a safe place if you can, and let us know where you are.
quick.describe: 112: Can you describe the people or vehicles involved?
quick.call_back: 112: We could not reach you. Please call 112 again.

robbery.1: Someone just robbed the store with a knife and ran off on foot!
robbery.2: Two masked men took my bag and drove off in a dark car.

shooting.1: I heard several gunshots outside, people are running!
shooting.2: Someone is shooting from a car, I'm hiding behind a wall.

assault.1: A man is beating someone up in the street, please hurry.
assault.2: My friend was punched and kicked by a group, he's bleeding.

theft.1: My car was stolen from the parking lot a moment ago.
theft.2: Someone stole my bike, I can still see him riding away.

traffic.1: A car is driving very fast and swerving between lanes.
traffic.2: A vehicle is parked across the road and blocking traffic.

domestic.1: The neighbours are screaming and something just broke loudly.
domestic.2: My partner is threatening me, I'm locked in the bathroom.

suspicious.1: A man has been trying the door handles of parked cars.
suspicious.2: Someone is lurking around the houses with a flashlight.

injury.1: I fell from a ladder and I think my leg is broken.
injury.2: A worker cut his hand badly, there's a lot of blood.

unconscious.1: A man collapsed on the sidewalk and isn't responding.
unconscious.2: My father fainted and I can't wake him up.

breathing.1: My son can't breathe properly, his lips look blue.
breathing.2: An elderly woman is gasping for air and can't speak.

chest_pain.1: I have strong pain in my chest and my left arm feels numb.
chest_pain.2: My husband suddenly got chest pain and is sweating a lot.

traffic_accident.1: Two cars crashed at the intersection, one driver is stuck.
traffic_accident.2: A car hit a pedestrian, the person is lying on the road.

overdose.1: My friend took something and now he's barely breathing.
overdose.2: Someone is lying in the park, there are pills next to him.

building_fire.1: There's smoke coming out of the apartment building, I see flames!
building_fire.2: Our kitchen caught fire and it's spreading fast.

vehicle_fire.1: A car is on fire at the side of the road.
vehicle_fire.2: Smoke and flames are coming from under the hood of a truck.

wildfire.1: Grass is burning on the hill and the fire is growing.
wildfire.2: I can see a forest fire spreading towards the houses.

rescue.1: Someone is stuck in an elevator between floors.
rescue.2: A person fell into the water and can't get out.

hazmat.1: A truck leaked some liquid and there's a strong chemical smell.
hazmat.2: There's a gas smell in the building and people feel dizzy.

breakdown.1: My car died in the middle of the road and won't start.
breakdown.2: The engine is smoking and the car stopped, I need help.

tow.1: My car slid into the ditch, can someone tow it out?
tow.2: A car is broken down and blocking the entrance, it needs towing.

flat_tyre.1: I got a flat tyre and I don't have a spare.
flat_tyre.2: Both tyres burst on the same side, I can't drive further.

reply.1: Yes, I'm still here. Please hurry!
reply.2: Okay. It's still going on, I can see it from here.
